reason: WebKit does not focus a button on a mouse click (Safari's macOS convention, as AppKit does); Chrome does. HTML leaves focusing steps on activation to the user agent.
A text input's intrinsic width (size=20 average characters) is the user agent's: WebKit 223 px, Chrome 201 px.
A native file input's intrinsic width is the user agent's: WebKit 182.25 px, Chrome 164 px.
